title: Rav Dimi bar Livai

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.27b.5-6): Abaye permitted him to fumigate baskets with sulfur.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Aramaic phrase is לכברויי סלי, fumigating baskets with sulfur. In the William Davidson digital text of Berakhot 27b, the permission is followed by “that was a mistake” and discussion of mistaken prayer times.
The linked Gemara gives Abaye’s permission to Rav Dimi bar Livai to fumigate baskets and then turns to whether an act based on a mistake stands. Hyman’s short notice records the permission.
